intro.q: What are fields by standard for?
intro.sub: By assigning catalogue fields to standards, the set of custom fields of every element type can be generated automatically, since each type takes on the custom fields of the standards that apply to it.
intro.cta: Use the column of standards on the left to see the fields of each standard.

intro.q: How are the fields of an element type put together?
intro.sub: The fields of an element type can be composed in three ways:
intro.autoTxt: from the fields by standard. The type takes on the fields of the standard or standards that apply to it.
intro.manualTxt: , by creating fields directly on each type.
intro.mixtoTxt: : taking on all or part of the automatic ones and adding directly created fields.
intro.cta: Use the column of types on the left to view/edit the fields of each element type.

grupos.title: Checkpoint grouping
grupos.sub: Decide whether the checkpoints of each checklist are split into groups, and how.

none.title: No groups
none.desc: All checkpoints form a single list, with no grouping.

fixed.title: Fixed groups
fixed.desc: Checkpoints are distributed into groups, and those groups are the same across all checklists.

variable.title: Variable groups
variable.desc: Checkpoints are distributed into groups, and those groups are defined case by case in each checklist.

grupos.info1: are the groups into which the AI suggestion distributes its checkpoints automatically.
grupos.info2: If you rename or delete any of them, those checkpoints lose their group and you will have to reassign them. Changing their color or adding new groups does not affect them.
